contract_term.quote: The term of the agreement is to be for a period of five (5) years, with an option in favour of the City to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions annually for an additional two (2) years.
contract_term.value: 5 years with an option to extend for 2 years

scope_of_deliverables.quote: Refer to the attached Scope of Work & Functional Requirements for further information.
scope_of_deliverables.value: The City of Medicine Hat is seeking a Learning Management System (LMS) to provide a platform for learning and development. The scope of deliverables includes the implementation, configuration, and support of the LMS, as well as data migration, testing, training, and change management. The successful proponent will be required to provide a comprehensive solution that meets the City's requirements, as outlined in the Scope of Work and Functional Requirements.

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote:
Assessments & Quizzes: Create, deliver and manage assessments, quizzes, and
surveys.
Learning Catalog & Search: Browsable catalog, tags, filters, keyword search;
configurable enrollment flows and approvals.
Learning Path: Create learning paths either mandated or recommended (optional).
Certifications & Compliance: Issuance and management of certifications, including
integration with compliance tracking. Certification paths, renewal/recertification windows,
grace periods, automated reassignments; audit-ready records.
Real-time Updates: Real-time content updates and notifications for learners.
Content creation: Course development platform standards & formats: Support SCORM
1.2/2004, xAPI (Tin Can), video, PDF, and web content. Optional: AICC, cmi5.
Gamification: Badges, points, leaderboards (configurable).
Integrations:
Integration and compatibility: integrate with other systems (e.g. content authoring
tools, third-party apps like Microsoft Viva, SharePoint, Email/Outlook, Unit4 Enterprise
Resource Planning System/HRIS and Finance System), with robust API support. Bi
directional data sync for organizational structure, roles, employment status, and learning
completions.
API Support: Robust API support for integration with other city systems, data sources,
and Learning Tools Interoperability (LTI). (Note if need middleware). API documentation
required.
Interoperability: Support for SCORM, xAPI, AICC, and LTI standards for seamless
content integration.
Technical Requirements:
Security & Privacy: Ensure data security. Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted both at
rest and in transit to protect against unauthorized access.
Single Sign On (SSO) and/or Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Secure login with
single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
Vendor Cybersecurity Compliance: Compliance with industry security best practices
(SOC2, ISO, etc.)
PIPA Compliance: Vendor server preferred within Canada to comply with
PIPA. Incident Response Plan: Vendor has an incident response plan.
